title: Ureteral stent: placement and removal
what: A stent is a thin, soft tube inside the ureter, the tube from the kidney to the bladder. It helps urine flow from the kidney to the bladder.
why: For stones, after kidney or ureter surgery, or when urine has trouble draining.
duration: placement or removal usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; the stent stays from a few days to a few months
tell_doctor: If you have a fever or pain now

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: A urine test is usually needed, sometimes a blood test. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Numbing
prepare.text: Sometimes the procedure is done with local numbing, sometimes under anesthesia. If you have anesthesia, do not eat or drink beforehand. The clinic will tell you the time.

prepare.title: Date
prepare.text: Write down the date when the stent must be removed or replaced.

steps: You lie on the exam chair or table
The urethra is cleaned, and a numbing gel is put in
The doctor passes a thin tool with a camera into the bladder
Through it, the stent is placed, or the old one is grabbed and taken out
The stent position is sometimes checked with an X-ray
feel: Pressure and an urge to pee during the procedure
After placement: frequent urges and a pulling feeling in your side, especially when you pee
Pinkish urine is common for the first few days
after: Drink more water, unless your doctor told you to limit fluids
A little blood in the urine is common with a stent
Do not miss the removal date. A stent must not be left in too long
After removal, the discomfort usually goes away in 1 to 2 days
red_flags: A fever over 38°C with chills: call emergency services
Severe pain in your side that does not go away
A lot of blood or clots in the urine

faq.q: Why do I keep needing to pee with a stent?
faq.a: The stent irritates the bladder. This is a common complaint, and your doctor may prescribe something to ease it.

faq.q: What happens if I forget to remove the stent?
faq.a: Minerals build up on it, and it can get blocked and stuck. It must be removed on time.

reminders.text: Stent procedure tomorrow. Bring documents and your list of medicines. If you have anesthesia, eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
